summary: T6F_sign_corrected failed Phase 6 500-step diagnostic with 49.3% sign correctness (target: >80%). Root cause: TWO critical implementation bugs prevent the sign fix from activating correctly. Bug 1: Pitch suppression reads arch_fix_active before it's set (0% activation despite 166 eligible steps). Bug 2: Band state never transitions from normal, preventing arch_fix from raising position cap during high-authority steps. Both bugs must be fixed before proceeding to Phase 7.
